title: Fourier coefficient of the sign encoding
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, let $A$ be a nonempty subset of $J$, and fix signs on the coordinates outside $J$. On the resulting restricted sign cube, the Fourier coefficient indexed by $A$ of the real-valued sign encoding $x\mapsto(-1)^{f(x)}$ is $-2$ times the coefficient indexed by $A$ of the indicator function of the event $f(x)=1$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite nonempty subset of $J$
Signs are fixed on coordinates outside $J$
